events.title: M 6.2 - 82 km ESE of Katsuura, Chiba, Japan
events.summary: Moderate offshore undersea earthquake registered at depth of 28.4 km. Minor coastal advisory issued; no major structural damage reported along the Boso Peninsula.

events.title: Pecan Ridge Complex Wildfire - San Diego County
events.summary: Fast-moving brush fire driven by Santa Ana winds; 4,200 acres burned with 35% containment. Evacuation warnings active for rural foothill zones.

events.title: Tropical Storm Halong Tracking Across Northern Luzon
events.summary: Sustained winds of 95 km/h with heavy squalls moving west-northwest into the South China Sea. Precautionary storm signals active.

events.title: M 4.8 - Reykjanes Peninsula Volcanic Swarm, Iceland
events.summary: Tectonic and magmatic intrusion swarm localized near Grindavík. Continuous ground deformation monitored by the Icelandic Met Office.

events.title: Great Migration Herds Converge Along Mara River Crossings
events.summary: Over 1.2 million wildebeest and zebras documented crossing the Mara River amid seasonal rain shifts, observed via aerial drone ecological census.

events.title: Deep-Sea Cold-Water Coral Reef Discovered in Galápagos Marine Reserve
events.summary: Marine biologists aboard Schmidt Ocean Institute vessel map pristine high-density coral habitat at 600m depth off Santa Cruz Island.

events.title: Sydney Harbor International Yacht Regatta Qualifiers Underway
events.summary: Challenging 22-knot south-easterly gusts test maxi yacht crews in the final tune-up trials ahead of the ocean championship.

events.title: Mont Blanc Autumn Alpine Skyrace Sets New Course Record
events.summary: Elite mountain runners complete the grueling 42km ridge traverse across crisp early-season snowpack under clear alpine skies.

events.title: Global Grid Interconnection Summit Ratifies Cross-Border Clean Energy Corridors
events.summary: Ministers and grid operators across 18 nations sign multilateral dispatch agreements to balance regional renewable surpluses.

events.title: International Immersive Cinema & Spatial Media Showcase Opens
events.summary: Pioneering spatial film directors premier interactive volumetric narratives, spotlighting real-time generative soundscapes.
